native_findings: Low-noise bark/canopy remain close. Lower conditioning retains more fine structure in high-noise canopy/fur and more grain, especially flat feathers/background; higher conditioning smooths fine detail. Lower strengths recover additional GT-correlated band signal and additional off-target energy. These four contexts do not establish a generally better prior or model.
